# Evidence fixture provenance

- `casas_canonical_valid.csv` is a minimal canonical-export fixture whose field model and activity/sensor vocabulary are derived from the Washington State University CASAS Aruba dataset catalog. It is test data, not a redistributed raw dataset sample.
- `ton_iot_telemetry_valid.csv` is a minimal processed-telemetry fixture whose required labels, device-family type, and metric shape follow the UNSW TON_IoT dataset description. It is test data, not a redistributed raw dataset sample.
- Existing network fixtures remain secondary compatibility coverage and are not primary frontend source choices.

Source profiles reviewed for Phase 2: https://casas.wsu.edu/datasets/index and https://research.unsw.edu.au/projects/toniot-datasets.
